Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -0400
Subject: Sandbox access — temporary hold request while purchase completes

Hi Markus,

Quick one — our procurement team started the PO for Redwood today but there’s an internal approval loop that could take 4–6 business days. The demo team is mid-integration and we risk losing momentum if the sandbox times out.

Is there any short-term option to keep our sandbox (dev.lumenix.redwood) active for another 7–10 days while the PO routes? We won’t need extra seats, just uninterrupted API tokens so engineers can finish the connector test.

I can attach the PO acknowledgement from procurement once available. Appreciate any temporary stopgap you can offer — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Jennifer Alvarez
Senior Product Manager | Lumenix Health
jennifer@lumenixhealth.com
Mobile: +1 646-555-0183

Hi Jennifer — thanks for the heads up and for looping procurement in.

We can absolutely avoid a hard cutoff while your PO is in flight. I can provision a 10-day "sandbox hold" on your existing project which preserves API tokens and quotas exactly as-is — no extra cost and no new seats.

Two asks so we can move this through our approvals:
- Can procurement send a short acknowledgment email (even a one-line reply) confirming the PO number or expected PO date?
- I’ll need a one-off approval from finance/security to record the temporary exception; copying Kimberly to expedite.

If procurement can confirm the PO number now, I’ll apply the hold today and follow up with a confirmation message that includes the internal ticket ID.

Markus
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com
